messages:
rita: late-night question  anyone have a 2515min doc or short film that feels like tea + a warm blanket? also want a 6-song 'reset' mini-playlist for when I get stuck putting furniture together :sleeping:
omar: short doc: 'The Silent Child' is actually a short drama ~20min, super moving. not a documentary but feels intimate. film festivals often have 200min gems.
dan: for mini-playlist (ritual): 1) Nick Drake  'Pink Moon' instrumental-ish vibe 2) Sufjan Stevens 'Mystery of Love' 3) Julie Byrne 4) Nick Hakim 5) Helios ambient track 6) Agnes Obel. 250min tops.
keiko: if you want a proper doc vibe: '20,000 Days on Earth' is 106m (too long), hmm. 'World of Tomorrow' is an animated short ~17m and oddly cozy + contemplative.
rita: love World of Tomorrow rec, never seen it. dan  can you post a quick spotify list? need something without weird energy spikes.
dan: sure, made a short list and pushed to queue-bot. link: https://spotify.example/mini-reset-ritual (not public)
queue-bot: Playlist created: "rita-mini-reset"  6 tracks  23m total. Added to #shared-playlists. 
omar: food rec for the pause: cheese on toast + honey + cracked pepper. 5 min.
rita: perfect. also curious: any micro-book rec? something you can read on the couch between two screws.
keiko: "The Little Prince" (the novella) is quick and sweet, or for micro-essays try 'Men Without Women' short story "Kawabata" (depends on mood).
rita: ok folks, trying World of Tomorrow after one shelf. will report back and maybe share a pic of the in-progress chaos :sweat_smile:
dan: please do. if you need an energizer halfway, drop 'All My Friends' by LCD for 7min of pure get-up-and-move.
rita: noted. thanks y'all :heart:
